description: This Java source file defines the PolicyTrie class, which implements a trie data structure for managing policies related to resource permissions. It includes methods for constructing the trie from policies, adding policy entries, traversing the tree, and generating JSON views based on permissions. The class is part of a package related to policy enforcement within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyTrie
classes.description: A trie data structure for efficient policy enforcement, mapping resource keys to permission indexes, supporting policy addition, traversal, inheritance, and JSON representation.

methods.name: fromPolicy
methods.description: Interprets a collection of PolicyEntry objects as a trie for policy enforcement.

methods.name: addPolicyEntry
methods.description: Adds a policy entry to the trie, updating grants and revokes for the corresponding resources.

methods.name: getSubjectIds
methods.description: Extracts subject IDs from Subjects objects.

methods.name: getJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: Converts a ResourceKey into an iterator of JsonKeys representing the resource path.

methods.name: seekOrCreate
methods.description: Finds or creates a trie node along the specified resource path.

methods.name: computeForChild
methods.description: Helper for recursively traversing or creating child nodes.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Map.compute wrapper for updating child nodes.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Records granted permissions for a set of subjects.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Records revoked permissions for a set of subjects.

methods.name: getGrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Returns the permission index at the current node.

methods.name: getTransitiveClosure
methods.description: Returns a version of the trie with inherited grants and revokes.

methods.name: computeTransitiveClosure
methods.description: Helper for transitive closure computation.

methods.name: getBottomUpGrantTrie
methods.description: Returns a trie with grants propagated from children upwards.

methods.name: getBottomUpRevokeTrie
methods.description: Returns a trie with revokes propagated from children upwards.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if a specific child node exists.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON representation of data based on permissions.

methods.name: getViewForJsonFieldOrNull
methods.description: Determines JSON view for a specific JSON field based on permissions.

methods.name: getViewForJsonValueOrNull
methods.description: Determines JSON view for a value, considering nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: getViewForJsonObjectOrNull
methods.description: Filters a JSON object based on permissions.

methods.name: filterCandidate
methods.description: Filters JSON content based on permissions.

methods.name: getViewForJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Filters a JSON array based on permissions.

methods.name: seekToLeastAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor node matching a path.

methods.name: seekToExactNode
methods.description: Finds the node matching the path exactly.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Traverses the trie according to a resource path and applies callbacks at termination points.
